name: Highharbor
description: A young white star with two giants and a long-period comet keeping the outer schedule. The giants' shadows shelter the harbor stations from the worst weather. Everything docks here eventually.

stars.name: Harbor Light
stars.description: A young white star spinning fast with a broad temperate band still mostly empty. Its debris disk glows with recent formation. Planets here are still counting late impacts.

planets.name: Breakwater
planets.description: A banded giant taking the system's weather on its broad cloud decks. Storms larger than worlds spin beneath the harbor lanes. Its gravity well shelters every station in the system.

planets.name: Roadstead
planets.description: A teal ice giant holding the outer anchorage in calm cold water. Methane haze wraps a slushy mantle undisturbed for eons. Anchorage fees fund the harbor's famous neutrality.

comets.name: Harbor Bell
comets.description: A long-period comet whose returns mark the harbor's festival calendar. Its tail brightens the anchorage for months at a time. Dockworkers time their contracts by its schedule.
